title: "Kalpha"
output: html_document
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
---

```{r, results='hide', warning=FALSE}
# load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(readxl)
library(irr)
library(knitr)
```

```{r}
# load dataset
pilot_raw <- read_excel("Pilot_Test_Sample.xlsx")
```


```{r}
# delete unecessary lines and replace Yes/No with 1/0
pilot <- pilot_raw |>
  select(-Q2, -Q3, -Q6, -Q7, -Q20) |> 
  mutate(across(Q8:Q19, ~ ifelse(. == "Yes", 1, 0))) |> 
  slice(-1) |> 
  rename("Review_ID" = Q4)
```

```{r}
# prep dataframe for ICR testing
long_data <- pilot |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = Q8:Q19,
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  )
```

```{r}
# rename the columns by variable names
var_info <- data.frame(
  Question  = paste0("Q", setdiff(8:19, 15)),   # Q8-Q19 without Q15 = 11 codes
  Variable  = c("Environment design", "Character appearance", "Audio", "Aesthetic dimension",
                "Plot", "Character building", "Narrative dimension",
                "Challenge", "Control", "Core mechanism", "Gameplay dimension"),
  Dimension = c(rep("Aesthetic", 4), rep("Narrative", 3), rep("Gameplay", 4))
)
results <- list()
for (v in unique(long_data$variable)) {

  temp <- long_data |>
    filter(variable == v) |>
    select(Review_ID, Coder, value) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = Coder, values_from = value)

  alpha <- kripp.alpha(t(as.matrix(temp[,-1])), method = "nominal")

  results[[v]] <- data.frame(
    Question           = v,
    N_units            = alpha$subjects,
    N_coders           = alpha$raters,
    Krippendorff_alpha = round(alpha$value, 3)
  )
}

alpha_table <- bind_rows(results) |>
  left_join(var_info, by = "Question") |>
  mutate(Agreement = case_when(
    Krippendorff_alpha >= 0.80  ~ "Good",
    Krippendorff_alpha >= 0.667 ~ "Acceptable",
    TRUE                        ~ "Tentative"
  )) |>
  arrange(as.numeric(sub("Q", "", Question))) |>
  select(Dimension, Variable, Question, N_units, N_coders, Krippendorff_alpha, Agreement)

kable(alpha_table, caption = "Intercoder reliability (Krippendorff's alpha) by Variable")
```
